name: Dante
source:
Dante's been [url=/c166890]Rex[/url]'s best friend since high school. He's loud, wild, and way too into parties and girls but that's just who he is. Underneath all that chaos, he's the most loyal guy Rex knows. No matter what kind of trouble Rex gets into, he's always got his back… Usually with a stupid grin and zero sense of danger.

[Edited From In-Game Description]
